Abstract

This resource comprises 253 biological records of beetles from three vegetation types (secondary forest, agroforestry systems, and wooded pastures) in the municipality of Convención (Norte de Santander, Colombia). The data in this biological record resource have been published as a Darwin Core Archive (DwC-A), a standard format for sharing biodiversity data as a set of one or more data tables.
